page.overview:
Who is Aquanox?

Aquanox is an aquatic translucent blue Spark. It appears in Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope.

In Sparks of Hope, the player can recruit Aquanox after completing a Battle Quest, Light Your Fire. The Spark does not belong to any hero, meaning any hero can use Aquanox in their team. Its skills consist of Splash Attack and Splash Protector to help Mario.
